name: Radar Systems Engineering
summary: How radar detects, ranges and images targets, from the radar equation to pulse compression, FMCW automotive radar and SAR.

topics.name: The radar equation and radar cross section
Pulsed radar, range resolution and ambiguity
Doppler processing, MTI and pulse-Doppler radar
Matched filtering and pulse compression (chirp waveforms)
Detection in noise and clutter, CFAR
FMCW radar and automotive mmWave radar
Angle measurement and tracking (monopulse, Kalman trackers)
Synthetic aperture radar (SAR) and ISAR imaging
